summary: Timeclock Status Fix Verification - All 9 backend tests PASSED, UI tests PASSED. Bug fix confirmed working: selecting an employee no longer incorrectly shows 'Working' status when no open shift exists.
critical_code_review_comments: Code review of timeclock_service.py shows proper implementation of OPEN_SHIFT_FILTER requiring missing clock_out
_normalize_inconsistent_shift_statuses() correctly repairs shifts with status=working/on_break but clock_out present
get_timeclock_status() properly returns 'not_started' or 'finished' when no open shift exists
Frontend TimeClock.js correctly maps status to button availability via getAvailableActions()
seed_data_creation: Test employees created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Timeclock status fix verified. Key fixes: 1) OPEN_SHIFT_FILTER requires clock_out to be null/empty/missing, 2) _normalize_inconsistent_shift_statuses() auto-repairs bad data, 3) Status endpoint returns not_started/finished when no open shift. UI correctly shows status badge and enables/disables action buttons based on status.
